mapper.select: SELECT um.finish_dates dates, m.pkg, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, IFNULL(uvp.min_pvn, 'unknown') register_version, IFNULL(uvp.max_pvn, 'unknown') version, u.id user_id, m.event_param event_type, um.state, um.updated create_time, u.dates register_dates, u.create_time register_date from diversion.user_mission um INNER JOIN diversion.mission m on (m.id = um.mission_id) INNER JOIN diversion.`user` u on (um.user_id = u.aid and m.pkg = u.pkg) LEFT JOIN diversion.user_hema uh on (uh.aid = u.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) LEFT JOIN (select uv.user_id, MAX(pvn) max_pvn, MIN(pvn) min_pvn from diversion.user_version uv where uv.dates <= #{dates} GROUP BY uv.user_id) uvp on (uvp.user_id = u.id) where um.finish_dates = #{dates}

SELECT um.finish_dates dates, m.pkg, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, IFNULL(uvp.min_pvn, 'unknown') register_version, IFNULL(uvp.max_pvn, 'unknown') version, u.id user_id, m.event_param event_type, um.state, um.updated create_time, u.dates register_dates, u.create_time register_date from diversion.user_mission um INNER JOIN diversion.mission m on (m.id = um.mission_id) INNER JOIN diversion.`user` u on (um.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN diversion.user_hema uh on (uh.aid = u.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) LEFT JOIN (select uv.user_id, MAX(pvn) max_pvn, MIN(pvn) min_pvn from diversion.user_version uv where uv.dates <= #{dates} GROUP BY uv.user_id) uvp on (uvp.user_id = u.id) where um.finish_dates = #{dates}
